implementation_choices.T: a second SkillNode built from the same spec with timeout 240, sharing the loaded policy object; its spec_hash differs and it is never saved. implementation_choices.holding_key_steps: env steps after which the agent carries a key
implementation_choices.seed_42: traced and labelled exploratory; not in any pooled number or reading
